privacyRule.appliesTo: every pay cell, city row, momentum row (each window) and posting family

method.firmIdentity: normalized company name, else domain, else shared_company_id (signal_population.firm_key)
method.staffingFirms: positively verified only: staffing segment or JobsPipe agency/broker majority, no conflicting evidence
method.payValue: hourly_mid of pay originally advertised per hour (USD); no period conversions, travel packages or stipends
method.employment: any employment label from a verified staffing firm; internships held out (2026-10-18)

sourceFields.pay_period: pay_benchmarks.pay_observations.posted_as (from canonical_jobs.salary_period for JSearch; salary_string wording for JobsPipe; the extractor's own unit for description pay)
sourceFields.currency: canonical_jobs.raw_json $.salary_currency (JobsPipe only; JSearch sends no currency field)
sourceFields.firm_flags: search_targets.search_error ('non-staffing employer...' and 'Excluded: real Industry classification...')
sourceFields.dedupe: pay_observations is one row per fingerprint_hash; canonical_jobs.duplicate_status = 'repost' dropped

method.newPosting: COALESCE(posting_date, first_seen_date); reposts and repeat fingerprints dropped

labels.label: Limited evidence
labels.rule: passes the publication rule but below Moderate

snapshot.label: Week of November 2, 2026
snapshot.note: Verified staffing firms, pay originally advertised per hour. Advertised pay, not actual pay.

observationWindow.basis: posting date (else last seen) of the observations used; pay table covers postings seen in the 90 days before sourceRefreshedAt

payObservations.note: Contract/temporary postings from verified staffing firms with pay originally advertised per hour

jobCityPayCombos.note: Job/city combinations, not fully covered cities

issueCards.title: North Dakota: an early upward signal.
issueCards.basis: Latest 45 days vs. previous 45, relative to all observed states. Early signal.

issueCards.title: Most-advertised pay snapshot.
issueCards.basis: Verified staffing firms, pay advertised per hour. Advertised pay, not actual pay.

issueCards.title: Highest observed city volume.
issueCards.basis: Observed postings, not verified open orders.

momentum.basis: Normalized posting momentum: latest 45 days vs. the previous 45, measured relative to the change across all observed states. Early signal — not raw growth, a demand forecast or a pay change.
momentum.historyNote: Early signals. Comparable history is still short.

mostPostedFamilies.note: Mixed granularity; several are broad families, not job titles.
